facts.text: Deploy source database to Azure SQL Database instead of on-premises SQL Server for faster data replication and easier self-hosted integration runtime setup.
Monitor CPU and memory utilization in Azure portal using Metrics for SQL Database; upscale if high consumption occurs.
Cloud migration is optimized for batches of up to 250 companies; reduce companies in batch if database has hundreds.
Update statistics and reorganize indexes on source database tables using sp_updatestats and index rebuild procedures.
Skip API data upgrade on company basis during migration, then run it after going live if extended upgrade time occurs.
Large data sets in companies should be broken into separate migration runs; each large company may need individual handling.
Use Cloud Migration APIs for moving many companies; find samples in BC Tech GitHub repository for automation.
